title: GitHub Release online updates
description: Fetch the source archive directly from a GitHub Release, verify download integrity and prepare a candidate version. No separate signed update attachment is required. The web application does not overwrite the running code.
no_staged_packages: No verified update package is currently staged.
stage_success: The Release source archive was downloaded, integrity-checked and placed in private staging.
stage_boundary: Downloading and preparing a candidate does not install it. Installation still requires backups, migrations, health checks and a service restart.
prepare_success: The Release source was prepared as a private candidate and passed release manifest, migration and PHP syntax checks. Nothing was installed.
github.title: GitHub updates
github.available: A newer release is available to download.
github.current: The installed release is up to date.
github.no_release: This repository has no stable release yet.
github.missing_assets: The latest release is missing signed website update files.

errors.input: Provide the full 40-character release SHA, metadata URL and signature URL.
